proofs.text: Put an executable at `node_modules/.bin/stryker` and put another `stryker` on the PATH; verify `binary()` returns the project's one. Remove both; verify `binary()` is None and that a run answers engine `none` with a reason naming `@stryker-mutator/core`

rule_text: The project's own `node_modules/.bin/stryker` is preferred over one on the PATH, and neither present leaves no engine with a line naming the package to install

tests.body:
def test_the_project_binary_wins_over_one_on_the_path(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    local = tmp_path / 'node_modules' / '.bin'
    local.mkdir(parents=True)
    (local / 'stryker').write_text('#!/bin/sh\n', encoding='utf-8')
    monkeypatch.setattr(stryker.shutil, 'which', lambda name: '/usr/bin/stryker')
    assert stryker.binary(str(tmp_path)) == [str(local / 'stryker')]
tests.name: test_a_missing_binary_leaves_no_engine_and_says_what_to_install
